name: POCO X7 Pro / Redmi Turbo 4
tagline: Experience the perfect blend of performance and customization with our Pixel-inspired custom ROM for your device.

steps.title: Pre-requisites
steps.description:
• Firmware: If coming from Modded Stock or HOS2, it is highly recommended to flash the latest HOS3 first before installing this ROM.
• Clean Flash is MANDATORY (due to new signing keys).

steps.title: Step 1: Flash Boot Images
steps.description:
Connect your device in Fastboot mode and run:
fastboot flash vendor_boot vendor_boot.img
fastboot flash boot boot.img

steps.title: Step 5: Sideload ROM
steps.description:
From your computer using:
adb sideload filename.zip

steps.title: Step 6: Reboot to Recovery
steps.description: You will be asked: 'Reboot to recovery?' -> Select YES.

steps.title: Step 7: Finish
steps.description: Once back in recovery, select Reboot System Now.

steps.title: Pro-Tips
steps.description:
• If your fod sensors or speaker feel uncalibrated after the first boot, go to Settings > Xiaomi Parts to calibrate them.
• The first Day You May Feel Heating, Battery Drain and Laggy. Please be patient!

installationGuide.warning: Clean Flash is MANDATORY (due to new signing keys). Incorrect installation may brick your device. Proceed at your own risk.
